body:
Introduces Wren and Elenia to the fleet and explains his guild’s view of exploration.

Recorded role and choices

Zeke escorts the visitors to the docks and describes planned northern-sea exploration, with the Radiant Dawn mapping and confronting dangers before Emerald Veil scholars investigate. His enthusiasm for the open sea gives that institutional account a personal basis. Statements about Zarathian destiny, individual freedom and the guilds remain his beliefs and explanations. The proposed expedition is not silently treated as completed.
